neighbours.label: a word right before 'University' in a university's name ('Virginia Commonwealth', 'Iowa State', 'Western Washington'), where 'University' is the likely next word; the output promotes 'u', ' University'
fire: Her son went to Ohio State University for a year.
He now teaches at Michigan State University near Lansing.
Researchers at Virginia Commonwealth University tested the drug.
She got her degree at Eastern Washington University.
A team from Santa Clara University won the prize.
He transferred to Case Western Reserve University in Cleveland.
Scientists from Kansas State University studied the wheat.
The speaker came from Northern Illinois University in DeKalb.
quiet: Ohio has many small towns along the old canal.
Lansing is the capital of the state of Michigan.
Virginia passed that law for the whole commonwealth.
Eastern Washington is dry and warm in summer.
Santa Clara County grew many plums long ago.
Cleveland sits on a great lake in northern Ohio.
Kansas grows more wheat than any other state.
Northern Illinois got a heavy snow last night.

notes: Card: ' State' x7, ' Reserve' x3, ' Commonwealth' x2, ' Clara' x2, 'ion' x2; promotes ' University'. Probe: ' Commonwealth' 0.771; ' State' 0.510 and 0.377; ' Washington' 0.493; ' Harvard' 0.206; the same words outside a university 0.003-0.011. As the label is about what comes next, near misses open differently and do not lead up to a university.
